summary: Fixed three mechanism-level bugs found live running Stage 2 of the eval suite's staged full run (note_candidates, proactive_decide, proactive_act) -- one leftover unit-rename fallout in production code (eval-harness-only impact), and one eval-only metadata-plumbing gap. All three corpora now run to 0 errors.
details: nora/subject/dreaming.py's dream(): key = workspace if chosen.key_kind == "workspace" else conversation_id still compared against the pre-rename string literal, while every real call site (nora/app/runtime.py, nora/__main__.py) already checks key_kind == "unit". This made the eval's single-pass proactive driver key every proactive adaptor call by ROOM instead of by UNIT, so the home-room lookup found nothing and every proactive_decide case errored 'the workspace names no home room, so the pass never ran'. Confined to this eval-only single-pass wrapper -- production's own HeartbeatLoop._keys_for already checked the renamed string, so live Nora was unaffected.
Same file, _staged(): NOTE_CANDIDATE.c.workspace -- the renamed SQLAlchemy column is .c.unit; note_candidates errored AttributeError: workspace before a single case could run.

evals/backbone.py's _as_nora_case(): never carried case.metadata through to the constructed evals.rebuilt.domain.Case, despite NoraCase.metadata's own docstring being 'whatever else the corpus recorded, carried verbatim'. proactive_act reads case.metadata['row']['note'] to know which reminder row it fires on; every ported act case refused with 'an act case must state the row it fires on' despite stating one in its own corpus YAML.

Also cleaned up ~90 accumulated note/note_candidate/decision_log rows in synthetic (hash-suffixed) eval workspaces left over from this and earlier debugging sessions' repeated runs against the same case names -- workspace_for()'s naming is deterministic by design (its own docstring already documents this exact accumulation hazard), so iterative debugging without cleanup silently duplicates seed rows across separate invocations.
Stage 2 result after fixes: note_candidates 20/1/0, proactive_act 11/0/0, proactive_decide 6/5/0 (pass/fail/error). Full suite: 8056 passed, 0 failed.
